title: Choose the visual world for TransNova SOC
question: The roll assigned Collection Cabinet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Collection Cabinet
options.lineage: natural-history collection drawers and their specimen labels
options.thesis: Every event is a catalogued specimen; every classification is a determination slip added beside it, never written over it.
materials: typed label stock with hairline rules
options.viewport: Green side rail with seven pages; Overview shows SOC state in one sentence, sensor rows with last-heartbeat age, open alerts as labelled slips, and the newest events as a quiet catalogue list.
options.risk: Label motifs can tip into museum costume if they leave the alert and event cards and creep into chrome.

raised.raise: A newly arrived event or alert stays marked as new until the analyst has seen it; rows never jump, they arrive.
The events table head names the first and last timestamp in view, so the analyst always knows which span they are reading.
One 4px module and tabular figures: IDs, counts and times align on a strict column grid.
Session bars in a source timeline are as long as the session actually lasted.
One hairline border system for every module; no shadows doing the work of structure.
Columns never move between refreshes; only their values change.

options.label: Chain of Custody
options.lineage: forensic evidence bags, tamper tape and custody tags
options.thesis: Every piece of evidence carries its custody tag: who observed it, when, and every hand it passed through.
options.viewport: Dark kraft-brown rail; Overview as a custody desk: sensors as intake points, alerts as sealed bags with tag numbers.
options.risk: Familiar forensic look that many security tools reach for; red tape tempts overuse of red.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: airport gate boards and segmented boarding passes
options.thesis: The SOC as a departures board: events rank by time and a change stays lit until noticed.
options.viewport: Dark top board of live events ranked by time, alert rows held amber until acknowledged.
options.case: Strong on live-feed clarity; weaker on investigation depth and the calm, welcoming brief.
options.risk: Dark board reads as a monitoring wall on a projector and invites the hacker-movie look the brief refuses.

options.label: Lexicon Page
options.lineage: nineteenth-century lexicon with guide words and coloured plates
options.thesis: Evidence set as entries with apparatus; corrections are struck and replaced, never erased.
options.viewport: Fixed-measure column of event entries with guide words naming the span in view; charts quarantined in bordered plates.
options.case: Its struck-and-replaced correction fits the audit trail well; a reading layout fights an operate screen.
options.risk: Cream plus serif is the category's AI default; reads as a book, not a console.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The visible construction grid is the design.
options.viewport: Monumental grid numerals over a visible cell grid.
options.case: Analysts and judges do not identify with type specimens; monumental type crowds evidence.
options.kept: A strict module and aligned tabular figures.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Time read upward on a centre staff.
options.viewport: Vertical staff of shaded action blocks.
options.case: Unreadable to this audience without training; bottom-to-top time fights every table.

options.label: High-Density Mosaic
options.thesis: Pack the screen with ruled modules.
options.viewport: Dozens of boxed modules on one scroll.
options.case: Density and red tabs contradict the brief's no-clutter and earned-red rules.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Rows flip in place as state changes.
options.case: A dark animated board is the monitoring-wall costume the brief rules out.
options.kept: Columns never move; only values change.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean light SaaS security console, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: White sidebar, KPI row, charts and an alerts table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every admin template by design.
